name: devices.batteries
doc: The batteries of connected devices (UPower, GNOME's Power > Connected Devices): {available, devices: [{id, kind, model, vendor, percentage, level, state, icon, address?}]}, without the computer's own battery and line power; event devices.changed {what: batteries}.

name: devices.bluetooth.adapter
doc: The first BlueZ adapter: {available, path, address, alias (the name others see), name, powered, discoverable, discoverableTimeout, pairable}; event devices.changed {what: bluetooth}.

name: devices.bluetooth.sendFiles
doc: GNOME's Send Files: starts bluetooth-sendto --device=<address> --name=<name> ({address, name?}), whose own window picks and sends the files.

name: devices.bluetooth.setDiscoverable
doc: {on}: makes the adapter discoverable while Settings' Bluetooth page shows (renewed every 60 s; ended on {on: false}, which the page sends when it goes and when its window closes, after 150 s without a renewal while the host lives on, and when the host stops); only undoes a Discoverable it turned on itself. Answers the adapter.

name: devices.color.addProfile
doc: {device, profile}: add a profile colord knows to a device (Device.AddProfile 'hard'; GNOME's Add Profile; polkit org.freedesktop.color-manager.modify-device).

name: devices.color.calibrate.cancel
doc: {}: stop the running display calibration (colord-session ColorHelper.Display.Cancel).

name: devices.color.calibrate.resume
doc: {}: go on with the calibration after the sensor was placed (ColorHelper.Display.Resume).

name: devices.color.calibrate.start
doc: {device, quality 0-2, kind (CdSensorCap), whitepoint 0|5000|5500|6500|7500, title, sensor?}: GNOME's display calibration with a colour sensor: Mutter's CalibrateMonitor for the display's connector (its session takes colord-session's UpdateGamma ramps through SetCrtcGammaLut and stops on Finished or a cancel), then ColorHelper.Display.Start; events devices.calibrate {state: sample|interaction|progress|gamma|finished, ...}.

name: devices.color.get
doc: colord's devices with their profiles (the first is the default), every profile and the sensors: {available, devices: [{path, id, kind, model, vendor, colorspace, enabled, embedded, default, profiles: [{path, id, title, kind, colorspace, created, systemWide, warnings, source}]}], profiles, sensors}; event devices.changed {what: color}.

name: devices.color.importProfile
doc: {device, path}: GNOME's Import File: the ICC copied to $XDG_DATA_HOME/icc, found or created in colord (CreateProfileWithFd, scope temp) and added to the device.

name: devices.color.installSystemWide
doc: {profile, device?}: GNOME's Set for All Users (Profile.InstallSystemWide; polkit install-system-wide, password dialog), then the device's default when it is named.

name: devices.color.makeDefault
doc: {device, profile}: the device's default profile (Device.MakeProfileDefault).

name: devices.color.removeProfile
doc: {device, profile}: remove a profile from a device (Device.RemoveProfile).

name: devices.color.setEnabled
doc: {device, on}: colour management for a device on or off (Device.SetEnabled).

name: devices.thunderbolt.authorize
doc: {uid}: Authorize a stored Thunderbolt / USB4 device (bolt Device.Authorize; polkit org.freedesktop.bolt.authorize, password dialog).

name: devices.thunderbolt.enroll
doc: {uid, policy?}: store and authorize a new Thunderbolt / USB4 device (bolt Manager.EnrollDevice, policy default|manual|auto|iommu, default 'default'; polkit org.freedesktop.bolt.enroll).

name: devices.thunderbolt.forget
doc: {uid}: forget a stored Thunderbolt / USB4 device and its key (bolt Manager.ForgetDevice; polkit org.freedesktop.bolt.manage).

name: devices.thunderbolt.get
doc: bolt's Manager and devices: {available, authMode (enabled|disabled), probing, defaultPolicy, securityLevel, devices: [{uid, name, vendor, type, status, authorized, connected, stored, pending, policy, parent, connectTime, authorizeTime, storeTime, ...}]} without the hosts; event devices.changed {what: thunderbolt}.

name: devices.thunderbolt.setAuthMode
doc: {mode: enabled|disabled}: GNOME's Direct Access switch (bolt Manager AuthMode; polkit org.freedesktop.bolt.manage, password dialog).

name: printers.add
doc: {name, uri, ppd?, ppdFile?, info?, location?}: a new queue or a new driver (cups-pk-helper PrinterAdd, ppd 'everywhere' for a driverless printer, or PrinterAddWithPpdFile); a new queue is then enabled, accepts jobs and gets A4 (as g-c-c). Answers {ok, name, new}.

name: printers.cleanHeads
doc: {name}: GNOME's Clean Print Heads, a CUPS command job 'Clean all' as the user; only when the queue's printer-commands has Clean.

name: printers.discover
doc: {address?, username?, password?}: without an address the network (Avahi _ipp/_ipps) and the scheduler's backends (cups-pk-helper DevicesGet, polkit devices-get); with one, a print server's shared queues, an IPP printer, JetDirect and LPD at that host, or the typed URI (smb:// only as typed). {devices: [{uri, info, makeModel, deviceId, location, class, network, driverless, source}], needsAuth?, denied?}.

name: printers.drivers
doc: {deviceId?, makeModel?, driverless?}: CUPS's drivers (CUPS-Get-PPDs) {drivers: [{name, make, makeModel, deviceId}], best: [...] (IPP Everywhere first for a driverless device), everywhere}.

name: printers.get
doc: {name}: one queue as printers.list has it, plus its PPD's option groups with the current values (Printing Options) and the IPP options number-up, orientation-requested and sides: {printer, ppd, options, ipp}.

name: printers.job.authenticate
doc: {id, username?, domain?, password}: GNOME's authentication of a job held for it (CUPS-Authenticate-Job with auth-info in the order of the queue's auth-info-required).

name: printers.job.cancel
doc: {id}: cancel a print job (cups-pk-helper JobCancelPurge, purge false; polkit job-edit / job-not-owned-edit).

name: printers.job.hold
doc: {id}: pause a print job (JobSetHoldUntil 'indefinite').

name: printers.job.priority
doc: {id, priority 1-100}: GNOME's Move to Top (IPP Set-Job-Attributes job-priority, as the user).

name: printers.job.release
doc: {id}: resume a paused print job (JobSetHoldUntil 'no-hold').

name: printers.jobs
doc: {name?, which? (not-completed|completed|all)}: every user's jobs of a queue or of all (IPP Get-Jobs): {jobs: [{id, name, state, user, printer, priority, size, created, held, authRequired, done}]}.

name: printers.jobs.clear
doc: {name}: GNOME's Clear All: every job of the queue cancelled on its own (JobCancelPurge each); answers {ok, canceled, failed} when one was cancelled, else the first error.

name: printers.list
doc: The queues (libcups CUPS-Get-Printers) {available, reason?, default, printers: [{name, title, info, location, makeModel, state, reasons, accepting, deviceUri, markers, canClean, jobs, isDefault, ...}]}; event printers.changed {}.

name: printers.remove
doc: {name}: remove a queue (cups-pk-helper PrinterDelete; polkit printeraddremove).

name: printers.rename
doc: {name, newName}: rename a queue (PrinterRename; no space, tab, '/', '#' or quotes).

name: printers.setAcceptJobs
doc: {name, on}: accept or reject jobs (PrinterSetAcceptJobs; polkit printer-enable).

name: printers.setDefault
doc: {name}: Set as default as g-c-c's printer_set_default: on this computer's scheduler the user's own lpoptions default goes, then PrinterSetDefault; with another computer's scheduler only the user's lpoptions default.

name: printers.setEnabled
doc: {name, on}: resume or pause a queue (PrinterSetEnabled; polkit printer-enable).

name: printers.setLocation
doc: {name, location}: the queue's location (PrinterSetLocation).

name: printers.setOption
doc: {name, option, values}: a default of Printing Options, a PPD option or number-up / orientation-requested / sides (PrinterAddOptionDefault; polkit printer-local-edit).

name: printers.testPage
doc: {name}: GNOME's Print Test Page (/usr/share/cups/data/testprint as a job of the user); answers {ok, job}.
